title: eludite/project/editReferences
description: Brief 0081: the Reference Manager's OK and a reference row's Remove: add and remove ProjectReference items (another project of the solution) and Reference items (an assembly by path, with a HintPath relative to the project, or a framework assembly by name) in one project file, preserving formatting. A project reference that would close a cycle (the referenced project reaches this one through its own ProjectReference items) is refused and listed in refused; so is a reference to the project itself. Added items go to the item group holding the project's other items of that type, else a new item group at the end. The host reloads the solution when it wrote.

generation.description: The generation the shell read the tree under. Not the current generation: -32801 (ContentModified), nothing written.

project.description: Absolute path of the project file being edited.

generation.description: The generation after the call: one more than the request's when a file was written (the host reloaded the solution), else the same.

reason.description: Why: cycle (with the path through the projects), self, missing, notReferenced.

reference.description: project: the project file's absolute path. assembly: an absolute .dll path, or an assembly name (System.Xml) for a framework assembly; for remove, the Include as eludite/solution/tree lists it also works.
